subject: octomind
title: Idle-time cache keepalive: max_tokens=1 ping on a frozen conversation snapshot resets provider cache TTL, with ping costs harvested and folded exactly-once into session cost
one_why: Extends pi's warmer from pre-emptive warming to TTL extension during human idle; provider-policy gated (Anthropic-only today) so unsupported providers never burn money, and warming cost is accounted, not invisible.

subject: octomind
title: Fold economics gate: compaction fires behind the fire line only when priced profitable in token ratios (cache-read, folder in/out, cache-write vs one uncached input token), with a hard ceiling entered early that no cooldown may cross
one_why: Most rigorous compaction profitability model in the corpus: ratios instead of dollars keep it provider-agnostic and defined when pricing is missing; depth is computed from measured session growth rate rather than a configured ratio ladder.

subject: octomind
title: PACT attention controller: deterministic evidence selection around the generative fold -- packet kinds, provenance enum (RealUser/ToolObserved/ValidatedSummary), KeepExact/Summarize/ArchiveReference lanes, SHA-256 packet digests
one_why: Runtime owns task pins, tool-call atomicity, and attribution checks; the model only folds -- cuts the classic failure where the summarizer silently rewrites provenance.

subject: octomind
title: Task-aware narrowing of oversized tool outputs by ONE cheap-model call selecting line ranges over a numbered copy, reconstructed verbatim from the original after lossless spill to a session file
one_why: Selection-not-generation: the model never retypes tool output, so nothing can be mis-copied or hallucinated into the transcript; irrelevant results become deterministic handles and any cut span stays readable on demand.

subject: octomind
title: Guardrails DSL with temporal capability-history conditions: guards match capability(arg=regex) plus has/when ['+/-capability'] evaluated against the session's tool-call log; denied calls are never spawned and never enter history
one_why: 'Use view instead of ls' only when no filesystem-read has happened yet -- policy as code with sequence semantics, bound before spawn and tested, unlike the corpus's static regex denylists.

subject: octomind
title: Supervisor authorizer: bounded tool-free LLM batch admission judged against persisted user-intent state (immutable parent boundary for delegated sessions) surviving compaction/resume; only exact grounded denials memoize, any policy/evidence change invalidates
one_why: Approval authority is durable session data rather than volatile context, so compression or resume cannot launder a denied intent back into admissible work.

subject: octomind
title: In-process kernel jail applied to self before any child spawn and inherited by shells/MCP/subagents: Landlock (Linux) / seatbelt (macOS), write-only isolation (RW cwd+XDG data home, read-only /), honestly documented limits and fail-open
one_why: Only subject applying Landlock to its own process rather than wrapping each spawned command; write containment is cheap and inherited, but it is opt-in, reads stay open (~/.ssh readable), and there is no egress control.

subject: octomind
title: LLM-free capability auto-activation: user intent embedded locally (ONNX muvon/octomind-embed) and matched against hand-authored capability triggers (mean-of-top-K cosine + margin); a hit registers the capability's MCP servers with no extra tool-call turn, LRU-evicted under a soft cap
one_why: Lazy tool/skill loading driven by local embeddings instead of model-initiated discovery: saves a routing round-trip per activation and keeps tool definitions out of context until the intent matches.

subject: octomind
title: Verify-gate on self-reported done: independent LLM verifier judges END STATE from typed evidence blocks (recorded actions with mut/read shape, ground-truth diff, read-back rounds), treats narrative as data, checks prohibitions as requirements, bounds re-runs at 2, and a PASS labels the trajectory so only verified work is learned
one_why: Strongest finish gate found: prompt-injection-hardened block typing plus observe-vs-change classification prevents both false gaps on read-only tasks and rubber-stamps on violated prohibitions.

subject: octomind
title: Interactive main loop under test: real binary driven inside a pseudo-terminal via a Python pty driver -- type a prompt, read the streamed answer, exit via /slash-command
one_why: The only mechanism by which the TUI input layer and terminal rendering ever execute under test; nearly every other subject leaves its interactive loop unexercised.

subject: octomind
title: Self-generated guardrails/skills promote only via counterfactual A/B: turns where a shadow artifact's trigger matched but was not applied form the control arm, live trials the treatment arm, scored on gate pass-rate gap vs a noise margin, retiring regressors -- off by default
one_why: Self-modification with empirical promotion: the agent cannot bake its own lessons into policy without beating its own shadow, which is the opposite of prompt-baked self-grants elsewhere in the corpus.

subject: octomind
title: Free every-turn detectors (identical-call repetition, no-progress window) fused with the agent's structured <sup>{json}</sup> self-report token before any model is woken; hints are advisory only and thresholds are fixed constants, not knobs
one_why: Second data point for detector-plus-advisory designs (crush rung), with the self-report protocol adding intent signal; deliberately never blocks hand-back, distinguishing polling repetition from true stalls.
